field_changes.old:
Plates keyboard — quickly dial in your working weight by tapping the plates you're loading
Labels — tag sets right from the record screen
Date picker — change a set's date without leaving the record screen
Weight unit switch — flip between lbs and kg in one tap
Folder notes — jot notes on any folder
Plus smoother keyboard, cleaner visuals, and crash fixes.
